Name: Feed Me Oil
Description: A physics puzzle about routing a stream of oil across the screen, placing fans, funnels and mirrors to redirect the flow.

Achievements.Name: Keen Feeder
Achievements.Description: Complete a level with +4 unused elements

Achievements.Name: Feed Genius
Achievements.Description: Complete a level with +5 unused elements

Achievements.Name: Buttons Cheater
Achievements.Description: Complete a level with a button without oiling it

Achievements.Name: Free Range Brain
Achievements.Description: Do not use hints in 15 levels

Achievements.Name: Organic Brain
Achievements.Description: Do not use hints in 30 levels

Achievements.Name: Thoughtful Feeder
Achievements.Description: Think for 5 minutes in one level

Achievements.Name: Keep Trying
Achievements.Description: Set the oil flowing 10 times in the same level
